messages:
maria.billing: Heads up — customer ACME Corp upgraded from Pro -> Enterprise on 2026-02-18 mid-cycle. System created a proration credit but then the card on file declined. They paid via PO (PO# PO-99872) a few days later. Now invoice 2026-02-18-4678 shows the full charge and a separate credit note, but the paid invoice balance still looks like it includes the charge (customer says they were double-billed). Can finance take a look?

dan.finops: Can you paste the invoice IDs and credit note IDs? Also which tax region? VAT can change calculation.

maria.billing: Invoice: `INV-4678` (amount GBP 12,450), Credit note: `CN-1122` (amount GBP 4,150) — that matches the proration calc we expected. Tax jurisdiction: UK (VAT). Payment: PO paid on 2026-02-22, payment ref `PAY-7788`. The problem is CN-1122 is still in state "issued" but not applied to INV-4678 in our ledger export. Customer provided screenshot showing bank/PO payment applied to INV-4678 but credit not reflected.

ashley.support: Customer reported this to support, raised ticket #SUP-9053. They want a partial refund or applied credit — they don't want a new invoice. Can we do a manual settlement if ledger is wrong?

samir.eng: Quick note from infra: proration credits are generated as draft credit notes when the payment method changes within 7 days of upgrade to avoid auto-applying to a charge that may later be voided. Looks like the state machine didn't transition CN-1122 to "applied" after PO payment because the PO path uses a manual payment flow. Repro steps I used:
```
1) create subscription S on 2026-02-01 Pro
2) upgrade to Enterprise on 2026-02-18 -> generate prorate credit CN (draft)
3) simulate card decline -> create manual payment tied to PO
4) payment recorded -> expected job: apply_draft_credits_for_payment(payment_id)
5) job skipped due to missing payment.type == "card"
```
We should either run the job to apply the draft CN to INV-4678 or flip CN to applied and update ledger.

billing-bot: Automated check: CN-1122 state: issued (draft=true), linked_invoice: INV-4678, payment_reference: PAY-7788, last_state_change: 2026-02-22T11:03:12Z.

dan.finops: If we apply the credit manually, will VAT lines change? Need to keep tax audit footprint intact. If credit reduces taxable amount, we must issue a VAT-adjusted credit note and ensure customer's VAT reclaim flow preserved.

samir.eng: The credit was computed with VAT at 20% for the proration window. If we apply the CN to the invoice, the invoice tax lines will be recalculated to net = 12450 - 4150 = 8300 and VAT = 1660. We should keep CN metadata and post an adjustment entry referencing PO-99872 and PAY-7788 for audit.

maria.billing: Customer is pushing for this week. Can finance confirm manual apply + ledger fix? If yes, I'll flag support to tell ACME and ask for any additional docs.

dan.finops: I can do the manual apply but want clear approval from compliance for VAT-side. @ashley.support loop in compliance? Also include note: why CN was draft (payment type mismatch).

ashley.support: Looping compliance: @compliance-team can you confirm manual application of CN-1122 to INV-4678 (PO payment PAY-7788) is acceptable from VAT/audit perspective? We will attach PO-99872 and customer confirmation. :pray:

billing-bot: Action created: FIN-TASK-9021 assigned to dan.finops - "Apply CN-1122 to INV-4678 and post VAT adjustment entry" (due 2026-02-26).

maria.billing: Thanks — will keep customer updated: "We have a finance task and compliance review; expect resolution within 48h."

samir.eng: Follow-up — I'll submit a bug fix to make apply_draft_credits_for_payment trigger for manual payment types too. PR drafted: r/infrabilling#782.

dan.finops: Good. I'll proceed once compliance signs off.

ashley.support: SUP-9053 update: Customer acknowledged timeline and shared PO copy. Keeping thread here for audit. :white_check_mark:
